726:     /** Disponibilidad de un slug (para el check en vivo del form). */
727:     slugExists: async (slug: string): Promise<boolean> => {
728:       const tenant = await db.orm.public.Tenant.where({ slug }).first();
729:       return tenant !== null;
730:     },
731: 
732:     /**
733:      * Alta de tenant + módulos iniciales en UNA transacción: si falla la
734:      * creación de los módulos (o el insert por slug duplicado), se
735:      * revierte todo — nunca quedan tenants parcialmente configurados.
736:      */
737:     createTenant: (data: {
738:       name: string;
739:       slug: string;
740:       vertical: VerticalValue;
741:       modules: ModuleValue[];
742:       tenantType: OnboardingTenantType;
743:       legalName?: string | null;
744:       taxId?: string | null;
745:       teamSize?: string | null;
746:       address?: string | null;
747:     }) =>
748:       db.transaction(async (tx) => {
749:         const tenant = await tx.orm.public.Tenant.create({
750:           name: data.name,
751:           slug: data.slug,
752:           vertical: data.vertical,
753:           tenantType: data.tenantType,
754:           legalName: data.legalName?.trim() ? data.legalName.trim() : null,
755:           taxId: data.taxId?.trim() ? data.taxId.trim() : null,
756:           teamSize: data.teamSize?.trim() ? data.teamSize.trim() : null,
757:           address: data.address?.trim() ? data.address.trim() : null,
758:         });
759: 
760:         for (const moduleName of data.modules) {
761:           await tx.orm.public.TenantModule.create({
762:             tenantId: tenant.id,
763:             moduleName,
764:           });
765:         }
766: 
767:         return tenant;
768:       }),
769: 
770:     /**
771:      * Suspende un negocio (panel CEO): guarda motivo + timestamp. El motivo
772:      * es obligatorio a nivel de acción; aquí solo se persiste.
773:      */
774:     suspendTenant: (id: string, reason: string) =>
775:       db.orm.public.Tenant.where({ id }).update({
776:         active: false,
777:         suspendedReason: reason,
778:         suspendedAt: instantFromMs(Date.now()),
779:       }),
780: 
781:     /** Reactiva un negocio (conserva el historial de suspensión). */
782:     activateTenant: (id: string) =>
783:       db.orm.public.Tenant.where({ id }).update({ active: true }),
784: 
785:     /**
786:      * Detalle completo de un negocio para el drawer: identidad, onboarding,
787:      * módulos, usuarios y métricas reales. `null` si no existe.
788:      */
789:     getTenantDetail: async (tenantId: string): Promise<TenantDetail | null> => {
790:       const tenant = await db.orm.public.Tenant
791:         .where({ id: tenantId })
792:         .include("modules", (module) =>
793:           module.select("moduleName", "active"),
794:         )
795:         .include("users", (user) =>
796:           user.select("id", "name", "email", "role", "createdAt"),
797:         )
798:         .first();
799: 
800:       if (!tenant) {
801:         return null;
802:       }
803: 
804:       const now = instantFromMs(Date.now());
805:       const [
806:         customersAgg,
807:         quotesAgg,
808:         paymentsApprovedAgg,
809:         paymentsAllAgg,
810:         membershipsAgg,
811:       ] = await Promise.all([
812:         db.orm.public.Customer
813:           .where({ tenantId })
814:           .aggregate((aggregate) => ({ count: aggregate.count() })),
815:         db.orm.public.Quote
816:           .where({ tenantId })
817:           .aggregate((aggregate) => ({
818:             count: aggregate.count(),
819:             total: aggregate.sum("totalAmount"),
820:           })),
821:         db.orm.public.Payment
822:           .where({ tenantId })
823:           .where((payment) => payment.status.eq("APPROVED"))
824:           .aggregate((aggregate) => ({
825:             count: aggregate.count(),
826:             total: aggregate.sum("amount"),
827:           })),
828:         db.orm.public.Payment
829:           .where({ tenantId })
830:           .aggregate((aggregate) => ({ count: aggregate.count() })),
831:         db.orm.public.Membership
832:           .where({ tenantId })
833:           .where((membership) => membership.endDate.gt(now))
834:           .aggregate((aggregate) => ({ count: aggregate.count() })),
835:       ]);
836: 
837:       const activeByName = new Map(
838:         tenant.modules.map((module) => [module.moduleName, module.active]),
839:       );
840: 
841:       const users: TenantDetailUser[] = [...tenant.users]
842:         .sort((a, b) => {
843:           const roleOrder = { OWNER: 0, SUPERADMIN: 1, STAFF: 2 } as const;
844:           const diff = roleOrder[a.role] - roleOrder[b.role];
845:           return diff !== 0
846:             ? diff
847:             : toJsDate(a.createdAt).getTime() - toJsDate(b.createdAt).getTime();
848:         })
849:         .map((user) => ({
850:           id: user.id,
851:           name: user.name ?? null,
852:           email: user.email,
853:           role: user.role,
854:           roleLabel: ROLE_LABELS[user.role],
855:           createdAt: formatDateShort(String(user.createdAt)),
856:         }));
857: 
858:       return {
859:         id: tenant.id,
860:         name: tenant.name,
861:         slug: tenant.slug,
862:         customDomain: tenant.customDomain ?? null,
863:         vertical: tenant.vertical,
864:         tenantType: tenant.tenantType,
865:         legalName: tenant.legalName ?? null,
866:         taxId: tenant.taxId ?? null,
867:         teamSize: tenant.teamSize ?? null,
868:         address: tenant.address ?? null,
869:         active: tenant.active,
870:         suspendedReason: tenant.suspendedReason ?? null,
871:         suspendedAt: tenant.suspendedAt
872:           ? toJsDate(tenant.suspendedAt).toISOString()
873:           : null,
874:         onboardingCompleted: tenant.onboardingCompleted,
875:         onboardingProgress: computeOnboardingProgress(
876:           tenant as unknown as TenantRowSource,
877:         ),
878:         city: tenant.city ?? null,
879:         whatsappNumber: tenant.whatsappNumber ?? null,
880:         websiteUrl: tenant.websiteUrl ?? null,
881:         instagramHandle: tenant.instagramHandle ?? null,
882:         googleBusinessUrl: tenant.googleBusinessUrl ?? null,
883:         paymentMethods: (tenant.paymentMethods ??
884:           []) as PaymentMethodValue[],
885:         createdAtIso: toJsDate(tenant.createdAt).toISOString(),
886:         createdAt: formatDateShort(String(tenant.createdAt)),
887:         updatedAtIso: toJsDate(tenant.updatedAt).toISOString(),
888:         lastActivityLabel: formatRelativeTime(tenant.updatedAt),
889:         modules: MODULES.map((moduleName) => ({
890:           moduleName,
891:           active: activeByName.get(moduleName) ?? false,
892:         })),
893:         users,
894:         metrics: {
895:           customersCount: customersAgg.count,
896:           quotesCount: quotesAgg.count,
897:           quotesTotal: toNumber(quotesAgg.total),
898:           paymentsCount: paymentsAllAgg.count,
899:           paymentsApprovedCount: paymentsApprovedAgg.count,
900:           paymentsApprovedTotal: toNumber(paymentsApprovedAgg.total),
901:           membershipsActive: membershipsAgg.count,
902:         },
903:       };
904:     },

## Solución: **asignar SUPERADMIN manualmente en la BD**

```sql
-- En Supabase SQL Editor
UPDATE "public"."User" 
SET role = 'SUPERADMIN' 
WHERE "clerkUserId" = 'TU_CLERK_USER_ID';
```

O desde el código (una vez):
```typescript
await db.orm.public.User.where({ clerkUserId: "tu_clerk_user_id" }).update({
  role: "SUPERADMIN"
});
```

---

Query to create superadmin: create tenant if none, then user upsert. But careful — creating a tenant from scratch requires vertical enum value. Let's check Vertical enum values.

## Diagnóstico

Ya verifiqué la BD: **las 15 tablas existen, pero `Tenant` y `User` están vacías (0 filas)**. Tu `UPDATE` no falló — coincidió con **0 filas**, porque nunca se completó el onboarding en esta BD. Por eso `/admin` sigue en 404.

Respuesta a tu pregunta: **un `User` NO puede existir sin tenant** — `tenantId` es `NOT NULL` con FK a `Tenant`. Como no hay ningún tenant, hay que crear uno primero.

---

## Query (Supabase → SQL Editor)

```sql
-- 1) Tenant de plataforma (solo si no existe)
INSERT INTO "public"."Tenant"
  ("id", "name", "slug", "vertical", "onboardingCompleted", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
VALUES
  (gen_random_uuid()::text, 'Nexus', 'nexus', 'construction', true, now(), now())
ON CONFLICT ("slug") DO NOTHING;

-- 2) SuperAdmin afiliado a ese tenant
INSERT INTO "public"."User"
  ("id", "clerkUserId", "email", "name", "role", "tenantId", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
SELECT
  gen_random_uuid()::text,
  'user_3KUbFGS9JStBtEFnbd8a4IGM29W',
  'TU_EMAIL@example.com',   -- ← pon aquí tu email real
  'CEO',
  'SUPERADMIN',
  t."id",
  now(),
  now()
FROM "public"."Tenant" t
WHERE t."slug" = 'nexus'
ON CONFLICT ("clerkUserId", "tenantId") DO UPDATE SET "role" = 'SUPERADMIN';

-- 3) Verificación (debe devolver 1 fila con role = SUPERADMIN)
SELECT u.email, u.role, t.slug, t.name AS tenant
FROM "public"."User" u
JOIN "public"."Tenant" t ON t."id" = u."tenantId"
WHERE u."clerkUserId" = 'user_3KUbFGS9JStBtEFnbd8a4IGM29W';
```

**Ojo con dos detalles del schema** (por eso la query no es un simple `INSERT`):
- `User.updatedAt` y `Tenant.updatedAt` son `NOT NULL` **sin default** → hay que pasar `now()` explícitamente.
- `User.id` / `Tenant.id` son `text NOT NULL` sin default → `gen_random_uuid()::text`.

Después: recarga `/admin` (logout/login si sigue en caché).

1: ---
2: title: instrumentation.js
3: description: API reference for the instrumentation.js file.
4: related:
5:   title: Learn more about Instrumentation
6:   links:
7:     - app/guides/instrumentation
8: ---
9: 
10: The `instrumentation.js|ts` file is used to integrate observability tools into your application, allowing you to track the performance and behavior, and to debug issues in production.
11: 
12: To use it, place the file in the **root** of your application or inside a [`src` folder](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/src-folder) if using one.
13: 
14: ## Exports
15: 
16: ### `register` (optional)
17: 
18: The file exports a `register` function that is called **once** when a new Next.js server instance is initiated, and must complete before the server is ready to handle requests. `register` can be an async function.
19: 
20: ```ts filename="instrumentation.ts" switcher
21: import { registerOTel } from '@vercel/otel'
22: 
23: export function register() {
24:   registerOTel('next-app')
25: }
26: ```
27: 
28: ```js filename="instrumentation.js" switcher
29: import { registerOTel } from '@vercel/otel'
30: 
31: export function register() {
32:   registerOTel('next-app')
33: }
34: ```
35: 
36: ### `onRequestError` (optional)
37: 
38: You can optionally export an `onRequestError` function to track **server** errors to any custom observability provider.
39: 
40: - If you're running any async tasks in `onRequestError`, make sure they're awaited. `onRequestError` will be triggered when the Next.js server captures the error.
41: - The `error` instance might not be the original error instance thrown, as it may be processed by React if encountered during Server Components rendering. If this happens, you can use `digest` property on an error to identify the actual error type.
42: 
43: ```ts filename="instrumentation.ts" switcher
44: import { type Instrumentation } from 'next'
45: 
46: export const onRequestError: Instrumentation.onRequestError = async (
47:   err,
48:   request,
49:   context
50: ) => {
51:   const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
52:   const digest =
53:     typeof err === 'object' && err !== null && 'digest' in err
54:       ? String(err.digest)
55:       : undefined
56: 
57:   await fetch('https://.../report-error', {
58:     method: 'POST',
59:     body: JSON.stringify({
60:       message,
61:       digest,
62:       request,
63:       context,
64:     }),
65:     headers: {
66:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
67:     },
68:   })
69: }
70: ```
71: 
72: ```js filename="instrumentation.js" switcher
73: export async function onRequestError(err, request, context) {
74:   const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
75:   const digest =
76:     typeof err === 'object' && err !== null && 'digest' in err
77:       ? String(err.digest)
78:       : undefined
79: 
80:   await fetch('https://.../report-error', {
81:     method: 'POST',
82:     body: JSON.stringify({
83:       message,
84:       digest,
85:       request,
86:       context,
87:     }),
88:     headers: {
89:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
90:     },
91:   })
92: }
93: ```
94: 
95: #### Parameters
96: 
97: The function accepts three parameters: `error`, `request`, and `context`.
98: 
99: ```ts filename="Types"
100: export function onRequestError(
101:   error: unknown,
102:   request: {
103:     path: string // resource path, e.g. /blog?name=foo
104:     method: string // request method. e.g. GET, POST, etc
105:     headers: { [key: string]: string | string[] }
106:   },
107:   context: {
108:     routerKind: 'Pages Router' | 'App Router' // the router type
109:     routePath: string // the route file path, e.g. /app/blog/[dynamic]
110:     routeType: 'render' | 'route' | 'action' | 'proxy' // the context in which the error occurred
111:     renderSource:
112:       | 'react-server-components'
113:       | 'react-server-components-payload'
114:       | 'server-rendering'
115:     revalidateReason: 'on-demand' | 'stale' | undefined // undefined is a normal request without revalidation
116:     renderType: 'dynamic' | 'dynamic-resume' // 'dynamic-resume' for PPR
117:   }
118: ): void | Promise<void>
119: ```
120: 
121: - `error`: The caught value is typed as `unknown`. Narrow it before reading properties like `message` or `digest`.
122: - `request`: Read-only request information associated with the error.
123: - `context`: The context in which the error occurred. This can be the type of router (App or Pages Router), and/or (Server Components (`'render'`), Route Handlers (`'route'`), Server Actions (`'action'`), or Proxy (`'proxy'`)).
124: 
125: ### Specifying the runtime
126: 
127: The `instrumentation.js` file works in both the Node.js and Edge runtime, however, you can use `process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME` to target a specific runtime.
128: 
129: ```js filename="instrumentation.js"
130: export function register() {
131:   if (process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME === 'edge') {
132:     return require('./register.edge')
133:   } else {
134:     return require('./register.node')
135:   }
136: }
137: 
138: export function onRequestError() {
139:   if (process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME === 'edge') {
140:     return require('./on-request-error.edge')
141:   } else {
142:     return require('./on-request-error.node')
143:   }
144: }
145: ```

Listo. Resumen del fix:

## Causa raíz
Prisma 8 decodifica `DateTime`/`timestamptz` con codecs **Temporal** (`pg/timestamptz-temporal@1`) y el runtime de Vercel no tiene `globalThis.Temporal` → `RUNTIME.TEMPORAL_UNAVAILABLE`. Antes no explotaba porque las tablas estaban vacías y no había nada que decodificar.

## Cambios
1. **`pnpm add temporal-polyfill@^1.0.5`** — dependencia explícita (pnpm strict no resolvía el peer dep desde el root).
2. **`instrumentation.ts`** (nuevo, raíz del proyecto):
```ts
export async function register() {
  if (process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME === "nodejs") {
    await import("temporal-polyfill/full/global");
  }
}
```
`register()` corre una vez antes de atender requests → el polyfill queda global antes de la primera query. (Vía oficial: "install a Temporal polyfill before creating the client", aunque aquí basta antes de la primera consulta porque el driver no lo usa en creación.)

## Verificado
- `pnpm build` ✅ (typecheck + build OK, `/admin` como ruta dinámica).
- Smoke test contra la BD real con el mismo driver: lee `User` y `Tenant` sin error.
- Tu usuario ya está: **`santiprocastellar7@gmail.com` → `SUPERADMIN`**, afiliado al tenant `nexus`.

69:     1,
70:   );
71:   const columns: ImportColumn[] = [];

73:     const header = headers?.[c]?.trim() ?? "";
74:     let sample = "";
75:     for (let r = dataStart; r < Math.min(rows.length, dataStart + 3); r += 1) {
76:       const cell = (rows[r] as string[])[c]?.trim() ?? "";
77:       if (cell) {
78:         sample = cell;
79:         break;
80:       }
81:     }

92: function findHeaderRow(rows: string[][]): number {
93:   let bestIndex = -1;
94:   let bestScore = 0;
95:   const candidateFields: ImportTargetField[] = [
96:     "code", "name", "unit", "unitPrice", "quantity", "category",
97:   ];
98: 
99:   for (let r = 0; r < Math.min(rows.length, 15); r += 1) {
100:     const cells = rows[r] as string[];
101:     let score = 0;
102:     let matches = 0;
103:     for (const cell of cells) {
104:       if (!cell.trim()) continue;
105:       const fieldScore = Math.max(
106:         ...candidateFields.map((f) => matchHeaderToField(cell, f)),
107:       );
108:       if (fieldScore >= HEADER_SCORE_MIN) {
109:         score += fieldScore;
110:         matches += 1;
111:       }
112:     }
113:     if (matches >= HEADER_MIN_MATCHES && score > bestScore) {
114:       bestScore = score;
115:       bestIndex = r;
116:     }
117:   }
118:   return bestIndex;
119: }

147: export function analyzeFile(params: {

152:   const errors: string[] = [];
153:   const parsed = parseFile({ buffer: params.buffer, fileName: params.fileName });
154:   const rows = parsed.rows;

165:       metrics: emptyMetrics(),

167:       warnings: [],
168:       errors: ["El archivo no contiene filas con datos."],
169:     };
170:   }
171:   if (rows.length === MAX_ROWS) {
172:     errors.push(`El archivo supera el límite de ${MAX_ROWS} filas; se analizó el primer bloque.`);
173:   }
174: 
175:   if (parsed.blockMode) {
176:     return analyzeBlocks(parsed, params.fileSize, errors);
177:   }
178:   return analyzeFlat(parsed, params.fileSize, errors);
179: }

196: function analyzeFlat(
197:   parsed: ReturnType<typeof parseFile>,
198:   fileSize: number,
199:   errors: string[],
200: ): ImportPreview {
201:   const headerIndex = findHeaderRow(parsed.rows);
202:   const headers =
203:     headerIndex >= 0 ? (parsed.rows[headerIndex] as string[]) : null;
204:   const dataStart = headerIndex >= 0 ? headerIndex + 1 : 0;
205: 
206:   const required: ImportTargetField[] = [
207:     "code", "name", "unit", "unitPrice", "quantity", "category",
208:   ];
209: 
210:   // Match por columna: si no hay header detectado, probamos verbos sin header.
211:   const mapping = headers
212:     ? compileMapping(headers, required)
213:     : guessMappingBySample(parsed.rows, dataStart, required, errors);
214: 
215:   const detectedColumns = headers
216:     ? headers.filter((h) => h.trim() !== "").length
217:     : Math.max(...parsed.rows.slice(dataStart).map((r) => r.length), 0);
218: 
219:   // Columnas para el editor: header si existe; si no, etiqueta + muestra.
220:   const columns: ImportColumn[] = buildColumns(parsed.rows, dataStart, headers);
221: 
222:   const parsedRows: ParsedRow[] = [];
223:   const pricesForOutliers: Array<string | null> = [];
224: 
225:   for (let r = dataStart; r < parsed.rows.length; r += 1) {
226:     const row = parsed.rows[r] as string[];
227:     if (row.every((c) => c.trim() === "")) continue; // filas vacías
228: 
229:     const values = valuesFromItemRow(row, mapping);
230:     const classification = classify(values.name, values.categoryRaw || undefined);
231:     const anomaly = detectRowAnomaly({
232:       name: values.name,
233:       unit: values.unit,
234:       price: values.unitPrice || null,
235:       quantity: values.quantity || null,
236:     });
237: 
238:     const warnings: string[] = [...anomaly.warnings];
239:     if (classification.inferred && values.name) {
240:       warnings.push("Categoría inferida automáticamente");
241:     }
242: 
243:     const parsedRow: ParsedRow = {
244:       index: r,
245:       kind: "item",
246:       raw: rawRow(row, mapping),
247:       values: {
248:         code: values.code || undefined,
249:         name: values.name || undefined,
250:         unit: values.unit || undefined,
251:         unitPrice: values.unitPrice || undefined,
252:         quantity: values.quantity || undefined,
253:         category: classification.inferred ? undefined : classification.category,
254:       },
255:       status: anomaly.status,
256:       reason: anomaly.reason,
257:       warnings,
258:       category: classification.category,
259:     };
260: 
261:     parsedRows.push(parsedRow);
262:     pricesForOutliers.push(anomaly.status === "OMIT" ? null : (values.unitPrice || null));
263:   }
264: 
265:   const outlierIndexes = detectPriceOutliers(pricesForOutliers);
266:   parsedRows.forEach((row, i) => {
267:     if (outlierIndexes.has(i)) {
268:       row.status = "WARNING";
269:       row.reason = "Precio atípico (outlier)";
270:       row.warnings.push("Precio atípico respecto al resto del archivo");
271:     }
272:   });
273: 
274:   const metrics = buildMetrics(parsedRows);
275:   const warnings = aggregateWarnings(parsedRows);
276:   errors.forEach((e) => warnings.push({ severity: "error", message: e }));
277: 
278:   return {
279:     fileName: parsed.fileName,
280:     fileSize,
281:     fileKind: parsed.fileKind,
282:     separator: parsed.separator,
283:     blockMode: false,
284:     columns,
285:     mapping,
286:     rows: parsedRows,
287:     metrics: { ...metrics, detectedColumns, mappedColumns: mapping.length },
288:     confidence: computeConfidence({
289:       mapping,
290:       rows: parsedRows,
291:       metrics: { ...metrics, detectedColumns, mappedColumns: mapping.length },
292:       blockMode: false,
293:     }),
294:     warnings: warnings.slice(0, MAX_AGGREGATED_WARNINGS),
295:     errors,
296:   };
297: }

299: /** Compila mapping por sinónimos (scores del fuzzy matcher). */
300: function compileMapping(headers: string[], required: ImportTargetField[]): ColumnMapping[] {
301:   // Avala cada header contra cada campo; elige el mejor par sin duplicar columnas.
302:   const used = new Set<number>();
303:   const result: ColumnMapping[] = [];
304: 
305:   for (const field of required) {
306:     let best = -1;
307:     let bestScore = 0;
308:     headers.forEach((header, index) => {
309:       if (used.has(index) || !header.trim()) return;
310:       const score = matchHeaderToField(header, field);
311:       if (score > bestScore) {
312:         bestScore = score;
313:         best = index;
314:       }
315:     });
316:     if (best >= 0 && bestScore >= HEADER_SCORE_MIN) {
317:       used.add(best);
318:       result.push({
319:         sourceColumn: best,
320:         sourceHeader: headers[best] as string,
321:         targetField: field,
322:         confidence: bestScore,
323:         needsAttention: bestScore < 90,
324:       });
325:     }
326:   }
327:   return result;
328: }
329: 
330: /** Sin header detectado: infiere por la primera fila de datos (con aviso). */
331: function guessMappingBySample(
332:   rows: string[][],
333:   dataStart: number,
334:   required: ImportTargetField[],
335:   errors: string[],
336: ): ColumnMapping[] {
337:   const first = rows[dataStart] as string[] | undefined;
338:   if (!first) return [];
339:   // 1) códigos → col 0 si parece código; 2) nombre → col con mayor texto.
340:   const mapping: ColumnMapping[] = [];
341:   const codeCol = looksLikeCode(first[0] ?? "") ? 0 : -1;
342:   if (codeCol >= 0) {
343:     mapping.push({ sourceColumn: 0, sourceHeader: "col0", targetField: "code", confidence: 50, needsAttention: true });
344:   }
345:   let nameCol = 1;
346:   let maxLen = 0;
347:   first.forEach((cell, i) => {
348:     if (i !== codeCol && cell.length > maxLen) {
349:       maxLen = cell.length;
350:       nameCol = i;
351:     }
352:   });
353:   mapping.push({ sourceColumn: nameCol, sourceHeader: `col${nameCol}`, targetField: "name", confidence: 50, needsAttention: true });
354:   const remaining = first
355:     .map((cell, i) => ({ cell, i }))
356:     .filter(({ i }) => i !== codeCol && i !== nameCol);
357:   if (remaining[0]) mapping.push({ sourceColumn: remaining[0].i, sourceHeader: `col${remaining[0].i}`, targetField: "unit", confidence: 50, needsAttention: true });
358:   if (remaining[1]) mapping.push({ sourceColumn: remaining[1].i, sourceHeader: `col${remaining[1].i}`, targetField: "unitPrice", confidence: 50, needsAttention: true });
359: 
360:   if (codeCol < 0) {
361:     errors.push("No se detectó encabezado: se usó la primera fila como dato y el mapeo es una estimación.");
362:   }
363:   return mapping;
364: }
365: 
366: function looksLikeCode(value: string): boolean {
367:   return /^[a-z]{0,3}[- ]?\d{2,}/i.test(value.trim());
368: }
369: 
370: function rawRow(row: string[], mapping: ColumnMapping[]): Record<number, string> {
371:   const out: Record<number, string> = {};
372:   for (const m of mapping) out[m.sourceColumn] = row[m.sourceColumn] ?? "";
373:   return out;
374: }

380: function analyzeBlocks(
381:   parsed: ReturnType<typeof parseFile>,
382:   fileSize: number,
383:   errors: string[],
384: ): ImportPreview {
385:   const blocks = splitBlocks(parsed.rows);
386: 
387:   // Encabezado de tabla de líneas del PRIMER bloque con líneas (para el editor).
388:   const firstBlockWithLines = blocks.find((b) => b.lines.length > 0);
389:   const lineHeaders = firstBlockWithLines?.lineHeader ?? null;
390: 
391:   const mapping: ColumnMapping[] = [];
392:   if (lineHeaders) {
393:     const push = (col: number, header: string, field: ImportTargetField, confidence: number) => {
394:       if (col < 0) return;
395:       mapping.push({
396:         sourceColumn: col,
397:         sourceHeader: header,
398:         targetField: field,
399:         confidence,
400:         needsAttention: confidence < 90,
401:       });
402:     };
403:     push(lineHeaders.name, "Descripción", "name", 100);
404:     push(lineHeaders.unit, "Unidad", "unit", 100);
405:     push(lineHeaders.quantity, "Cant/Rend", "quantity", 100);
406:     push(lineHeaders.price, "Precio Unitario", "unitPrice", 100);
407:   }
408: 
409:   const parsedRows: ParsedRow[] = [];
410: 
411:   for (const block of blocks) {
412:     const normalizedLines: ApuImportLine[] = [];
413:     let invalidLines = 0;
414:     for (const line of block.lines) {
415:       const unit = normalizeUnit(line.unit);
416:       const quantity = normalizeNumber(line.quantity);
417:       const price = normalizeNumber(line.price);
418:       if (!line.name.trim() || price === null || Number(price) <= 0) {
419:         invalidLines += 1;
420:         continue;
421:       }
422:       normalizedLines.push({
423:         name: collapseSpaces(line.name),
424:         unit: unit || "UND",
425:         quantity: quantity && Number(quantity) > 0 ? quantity : "1",
426:         price,
427:         category: line.category ?? undefined,
428:       });
429:     }
430: 
431:     const warnings: string[] = [];
432:     let status: ParsedRow["status"] = "OK";
433:     let reason: string | undefined;
434: 
435:     if (normalizedLines.length === 0) {
436:       status = block.name ? "WARNING" : "OMIT";
437:       reason = block.name ? "Actividad sin líneas válidas" : "Bloque sin nombre ni líneas";
438:       warnings.push(reason);
439:     } else if (invalidLines > 0) {
440:       status = "WARNING";
441:       reason = `${invalidLines} línea(s) sin precio válido se omitirán`;
442:       warnings.push(reason);
443:     }
444: 
445:     const firstCategory = normalizedLines.find((l) => l.category)?.category;
446: 
447:     parsedRows.push({
448:       index: block.rowIndexes[0] ?? 0,
449:       kind: "activity",
450:       raw: {},
451:       values: {
452:         activityCode: normalizeCode(block.code) || undefined,
453:         activityName: block.name || undefined,
454:         activityUnit: block.unit || undefined,
455:         linesJson: JSON.stringify(normalizedLines),
456:         category: firstCategory,
457:       },
458:       status,
459:       reason,
460:       warnings,
461:       category: firstCategory,
462:     });
463:   }
464: 
465:   const metrics = buildMetrics(parsedRows);
466:   const warnings = aggregateWarnings(parsedRows);
467:   errors.forEach((e) => warnings.push({ severity: "error", message: e }));
468: 
469:   return {
470:     fileName: parsed.fileName,
471:     fileSize,
472:     fileKind: parsed.fileKind,
473:     blockMode: true,
474:     columns: [],
475:     mapping,
476:     rows: parsedRows,
477:     metrics: {
478:       ...metrics,
479:       detectedColumns: mapping.length,
480:       mappedColumns: mapping.length,
481:     },
482:     confidence: computeConfidence({
483:       mapping,
484:       rows: parsedRows,
485:       metrics: { ...metrics, detectedColumns: mapping.length, mappedColumns: mapping.length },
486:       blockMode: true,
487:     }),
488:     warnings: warnings.slice(0, MAX_AGGREGATED_WARNINGS),
489:     errors,
490:   };
491: }
492: 
493: function buildMetrics(rows: ParsedRow[]): ImportMetrics {
494:   const metrics = emptyMetrics();
495:   metrics.totalRows = rows.length;
496:   for (const row of rows) {
497:     if (row.status === "OK") metrics.validRows += 1;
498:     else if (row.status === "WARNING") metrics.warningRows += 1;
499:     else metrics.omittedRows += 1;
500: 
501:     if (row.kind === "item") metrics.detectedItems += 1;
502:     else metrics.detectedActivities += 1;
503: 
504:     if (row.warnings.some((w) => w.includes("Categoría inferida"))) {
505:       metrics.inferredCategories += 1;
506:     }
507:     if (row.warnings.some((w) => w.includes("atípico"))) {
508:       metrics.priceOutliers += 1;
509:     }
510:   }
511:   return metrics;
512: }
513: 
514: function aggregateWarnings(rows: ParsedRow[]): ImportPreview["warnings"] {
515:   const out: ImportPreview["warnings"] = [];
516:   for (const row of rows) {
517:     if (row.status === "OMIT") {
518:       out.push({
519:         rowIndex: row.index,
520:         severity: "warning",
521:         message: row.reason ?? "Fila omitida",
522:       });
523:     } else if (row.status === "WARNING") {
524:       out.push({
525:         rowIndex: row.index,
526:         severity: "warning",
527:         message: row.reason ?? row.warnings.join("; "),
528:       });
529:     }
530:   }
531:   return out;
532: }

684: function normalizeTextKey(value: string): string {

**Vercel Hobby = 10s máx por Serverless Function** (ignora `maxDuration: 60` en vercel.json).  
Un XLSX de 16 MB con `XLSX.read()` + análisis sincrónico = **~12-18s** → **siempre timeout**.

| Opción | Qué implica |
|--------|-------------|
| **Upgrade Vercel Pro ($20/mes)** | Límite 60s → el parse actual pasa |
| **Background job (cola)** | Cliente sube a Blob → dispara job (Vercel Cron / Inngest / Upstash QStash) → webhook cuando termina → UI refresca |
| **Pre-parse en cliente (Web Worker)** | `xlsx` en worker del navegador → envía JSON ya parseado (sin límite 10s) |
| **Dividir el MASTER PACK** | Varios archivos < 4.5 MB → ruta directa actual (sin Blob) |

---

**Recomendación rápida:** si es un pack que subes *tú* ocasionalmente, **divídelo en 3-4 archivos** (cada < 4.5 MB) y usa la importación normal (sin Blob). Si lo suben *clientes* recurrentemente → **cola background** o **Vercel Pro**.

ITEM_BATCH_SIZE) {\n    const batch = items.slice(i, i + ITEM_BATCH_SIZE);\n    await db.transaction(async (tx) => {\n      for (const item of batch) {\n        const existing = item.code\n          ? await tx.orm.public.ApuItem.where({ id: existing.id }).update({\n            name: item.name,\n            unit: item.unit,\n            unitPrice: item.unitPrice,\n            category: item.category ?? \"MATERIAL\",\n          });\n          itemIdByKey.set(item.key, existing.id);\n          updated++;\n        } else {\n          const createdItem = await tx.orm.public.ApuItem.create({\n            tenantId,\n            code: item.code ?? null,\n            name: item.name,\n            unit: item.unit,\n            unitPrice: item.unitPrice,\n            category: item.category ?? \"MATERIAL\",\n          });\n          itemIdByKey.set(item.key, createdItem.id);\n          created++;\n        }\n      }\n    });\n    console.log(`   Insumos lote ${Math.floor(i/ITEM_BATCH_SIZE)+1}/${Math.ceil(items.length/ITEM_BATCH_SIZE)}: +${created} creados, ~${updated} actualizados`);\n  }\n  return { created, updated, itemIdByKey };\n}\n\nasync function upsertActivitiesBatched(\n  tenantId: string,\n  activities: PlannedActivity[],\n  itemIdByKey: Map<string, string>\n): Promise<BatchResult> {\n  const result: BatchResult = {\n    createdItems: 0, updatedItems: 0,\n    createdActivities: 0, updatedActivities: 0,\n    createdCompositions: 0, omittedRows: 0,\n    warnings: 0, errors: [],\n  };\n\n  for (let i = 0; i < activities.length; i += ACTIVITY_BATCH_SIZE) {\n    const batch = activities.slice(i, i + ACTIVITY_BATCH_SIZE);\n    console.log(`   Procesando actividades ${i+1}–${Math.min(i+ACTIVITY_BATCH_SIZE, activities.length)} de ${activities.length}...`);\n\n    await db.transaction(async (tx) => {\n      for (const act of batch) {\n        // 1) Upsert actividad\n        const existingAct = act.code\n          ? await tx.orm.public.ApuActivity.where({ tenantId, code: act.code }).first()\n          : await tx.orm.public.ApuActivity.where({ tenantId, name: act.name }).first();\n\n        let activityId: string;\n        if (existingAct) {\n          await tx.orm.public.ApuActivity.where({ id: existingAct.id }).update({\n            name: act.name,\n            unit: act.unit,\n            description: null,\n          });\n          activityId = existingAct.id;\n          result.updatedActivities++;\n        } else {\n          const createdAct = await tx.orm.public.ApuActivity.create({\n            tenantId,\n result.createdActivities++;\n        }\n\n        // 2) Borrar composiciones existentes de esta actividad\n        await tx.orm.public.ApuActivityComposition.deleteMany({\n          where: { tx.orm.public.ApuItem.where({\n              tenantId,\n              name: { equals: line.itemName, mode: \"insensitive\" },\n            }).first();\n            if (!found) {\n              result.warnings++;\n              result.errors.push(`Insumo no encontrado para línea: ${line.itemName}`);\n              continue;\n            }\n            // Usar el encontrado\n            await           result.createdCompositions++;\n            continue;\n          }\n\n          await tx.orm.public.ApuActivityComposition.create({\n            activityId,\n            itemId,\n            consumption: line.quantity,\n            wastePercent: 0,\n          });\n          result.createdCompositions++;\n        }\n      }\n    });\n  }\n  return result;\n}\n\nasync function main() {\n
